title: PrimaryWedge
description: The SINGLE outreach wedge chosen for one prospect (scripts/wedge_selection.py), stored at data/leads/<slug>/primary_wedge.json. Exactly one per prospect -- never a list of issues. why_now is copied verbatim from the prospect's already-resolved V3.1.1 field (never recomputed or invented here); null is a valid, common, non-disqualifying value for a QUALIFIED lead.

observation.description: The specific, checkable, prospect-specific observation -- must pass the company-swap test

commercial_mechanism.description: The acquisition mechanism in plain terms -- never a generic 'this hurts SEO' statement
